description: This file defines a PHP trait ImpactDataRelationsTrait used within a Goteo application to manage relationships between models and impact data. It includes methods for adding, checking, retrieving, listing, and removing impact data associations in a database, utilizing SQL queries and related ImpactData class methods.

methods.name: getImpactDataTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the impact data relationship table based on the model's table name.

methods.name: addImpactData
methods.description: Adds an association between the current model and a given ImpactData instance, with an order parameter.

methods.name: hasImpactData
methods.description: Checks if the current model has an association with a specific ImpactData.

methods.name: getAllImpactData
methods.description: Retrieves all ImpactData associated with the current model, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: getListOfImpactData
methods.description: Retrieves a filtered list of ImpactData associated with the current model, supporting pagination.

methods.name: removeImpactData
methods.description: Removes the association between the current model and a specified ImpactData.
